about.title: About WhatsApp Dual
about.description: Use WhatsApp Personal and Business in a single app.
about.author: Author

help.quickHelpIntro: The most useful actions are grouped here so you can get around the app quickly.
help.quickHelpAccounts: Switch between Personal and Business instantly with Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2.
help.quickHelpSettings: Open Settings with Ctrl+, to change language, theme, startup behavior, and security.
help.quickHelpLock: Enable a 4-8 digit PIN and lock the app immediately with Ctrl+L when protection is enabled.
help.quickHelpTray: If minimize to tray is enabled, closing the main window keeps WhatsApp Dual running in the tray.
help.quickHelpUpdates: Use the updates option to check, download, and install newer versions.
help.troubleshootingIntro: Start with the quickest fixes before re-pairing your accounts.
help.troubleshootingReload: If a view looks frozen or stale, reload the active account with Ctrl+R.
help.troubleshootingLogin: If QR login expires or a session disconnects, re-scan the affected account.
help.troubleshootingNotifications: If notifications are missing, confirm system notifications are allowed for WhatsApp Dual.
help.troubleshootingUpdates: If update download is not available, install the latest package manually from the releases page.
help.troubleshootingSecurity: If you forget the PIN, reset the protected sessions and link the accounts again.
